title: Quantised snapshots and deltas
hints: Encode by walking both sorted lists together, like a merge: the smaller id is either removed (only in the baseline) or new (only in the current snapshot); equal ids are compared field by field.
Decode into a `std::map` keyed by id, starting from the baseline. Check each length before you read it, and compare the final read position with the size of the data.

NaN ("not a number", what `0.0f / 0.0f` gives) compares false with everything, so `value < min` and `value > max` both let it through the clamp. Test for it first with `std::isnan(value)` from `<cmath>`. `std::lround(x)` (also `<cmath>`) rounds to the nearest whole number, halves away from zero, and returns a `long`.
